title: The Obscured Canvas
summary: Knowledge accumulates like marks on white paper until the marks are mistaken for the whole of reality.

blocks.title: The Obscured Canvas
blocks.subtitle: The map can be correct without being complete.

paragraphs: The canvas is not an argument against knowledge. The marks are useful, often beautiful, and frequently correct.
The error begins when their density makes the unmarked space impossible to perceive.

blocks.text: The paper was always white. We just couldn't see it anymore.
